translations.web: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
translations.bsb: We have a little sister, and her breasts are not yet grown. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?
translations.kjv: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
